## Contribution type

Select one:

- [ ] Standard: bug fix, documentation, tests, or a small improvement
- [ ] Custom: a new workflow, interface behavior, or integration

## Related request

Link the issue or contribution proposal, if one exists: Closes #

## What changes and why

Describe the user problem and the solution. For a custom change, explain its scope and any alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] `make test` passes, or I explain below why it does not apply
- [ ] I checked visual changes in the running app, including light and dark mode, or no UI changed
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible behavior or data sent to Google, or no update is needed
- [ ] Apple translation remains on device; no translated text is stored or logged
